messages:
deploy-bot: Emergency hotfix requested for embeddings-service. Image: rwinference/embeds:1.5.2-hotfix. Preflight OK. Requesting expedited canary + fast ramp in 10m. Logs: https://logs.redwood/embeds/1767770001 :rotating_light:

eng-dev-ty: Summary: regression in tiny-batch path causing sporadic 502s and p99 spikes. Patch is a focused fix to the coalescer logic. Rollback target: rwinference/embeds:1.5.1.

sre-iva: Need explicit rollback criteria and owner to execute. Suggest triggers: 5xx >0.5% sustained 2m OR p95 increase >250ms for 3m. Who will cut traffic?

oncall-max: I'm oncall and will execute traffic cut if triggered. Pager set to high for 90m.

product-june: Product ack. Impact small but user visible. Approve expedited rollout. Short blurb for release notes: "Fix for intermittent 502s / latency for very short embedding requests. No model changes."

release-cory: Need Eng + SRE + Product signoffs documented. Eng signoff?

eng-dev-ty: +1 from eng (codeowner). Can do canary eu-west1 -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% if healthy.

sre-iva: SRE +1, will monitor dashboards and set temporary alerts for tiny-batch p99. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/embeds-hotfix

deploy-bot: Canary started: embed-canary-21 (eu-west1). Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/embeds/canary/1767770001

sre-iva: Canary initial checks PASS. p95 normalized after 3m.

deploy-bot: Initiating ramp to 20%. Will update at checkpoints.

oncall-max: Watch: if I post "ROLLBACK INTENT" I'll run `kubectl rollout undo deployment/embeds --to-revision=1.5.1` and then `POST /ops/traffic?service=embeds&target=1.5.1`.

deploy-bot: 20% reached. Monitoring.

sre-iva: 8m into 20%: metrics stable, no 5xx spike. Proceed to 60%.

deploy-bot: 60% reached. Monitoring 12m checkpoint.

eng-dev-ty: Observed one node with noisy GC at 60% but not widespread. No rollback.

sre-iva: 10m into 60%: stable. No trigger breaches.

deploy-bot: Finalizing rollout: switching 100% to rwinference/embeds:1.5.2-hotfix. Deployment complete. Artifact SHA: e1f2d3c4.

release-cory: Posting release-note snippet to confluence and queuing customer note after 30m checks. Scheduling 2h post-deploy sync to capture learnings.

eng-dev-ty: Follow-ups: add regression test for tiny-batch coalescer and an early-warning canary metric. Filing ticket: https://jira.redwood/browse/ENG-10101

oncall-max: Pager active for 2h. If I detect issues I'll post rollback intent with metric snapshots and execute immediately.

release-cory: Closing thread: expedited hotfix rolled and approvals recorded. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
